campaign: Transfer audio.cpp behavior into reusable Go audio operations and prove the CPU ingest-train-evaluate-serve lifecycle before broader architectures and CUDA
doctrine: Work and commit only in overgo_audiocpp; do not push, write in master, or import master's plan. Honor explicit stops. Synchronize a pinned validated master only at an implementation-group boundary when relevant changes warrant it or the user requests it; preserve the exact audio parent plan through first-parent-target completion, then replan separately. Do not recursively merge after merge commits or between a group's retained receipts. An urgent demonstrated safety fix may interrupt with affected evidence revalidation. Transfer each capability through a pinned behavioral oracle, never a linked runtime or permanent cross-repository dependency. Granite Speech 5.0 470M TurboCTC is the offline reference, native Safetensors Nemotron 3.5 ASR the recurrent/streaming reference, and FireRedVAD the activity reference; the incompatible Q8 GGUF remains rejected. Pin source revision, license, artifact, fixture, transform and independent boundary traces with explicit tolerances. CPU is the numerical authority. Model identities, tensor names, geometry, padding, normalization, ties and composition belong in declarations, never family-specific execution branches. A common operation may have one recipe consumer; add it only for a demonstrated missing behavior with its real consumer and tests. Reuse audiodsp, media.DecodeAudio, safetensors, tokenizer, hostmath/tensor, modelrecipe, capabilityruntime, dataset, evaluation, runrecord, trainingprogram and trainingworkflow. Keep one inference/training forward path and the existing loader, scheduler, optimizer, checkpoint and publication owners. Do not add a graph engine, parallel registry, dataset cache, umbrella audio service or verifier framework. ASR, synthesis, activity, alignment and speaker operations retain separate typed contracts. Consolidation migrates every actual caller and deletes displaced APIs in the same slice; measure state, buffer and API reduction alongside unchanged accepted behavior and explicit refusals. Preserve separate GeneratedAudio, AudioReference and transcript artifacts; synthesis silence does not inherit ASR silence refusal. Preserve the committed CPU ingest-train-evaluate-serve lifecycle, production command/library parity, frozen-final-feature adapter, tied projection ownership, exact stop and resume, pre/post WER and resource evidence, authenticated transcription, cancellation and publication recovery. Resume includes optimizer, random, scheduler and data-stream state. Reuse existing frozen-component training and persist full input/transform/checkpoint lineage. Wider encoder gradients, internal adapters, recurrent-decoder training and CUDA are separate capabilities, not established by that CTC adapter proof. Decode actual samples with complete rejection denominators. Use pinned LibriSpeech clean first; quarantine policy-invalid, silent, near-silent, corrupt, clipped and non-finite ASR inputs. Historical silent AMI materialization stays quarantined until its exact source and transform are established. Historical ingestion failures require replay against the original store and immutable identities, not isolated-store success alone. Reference text never enters prediction. Reuse bounded source-addressed Parquet/Arrow traversal and immutable scoring outputs; do not copy a corpus or cache predictions for timing. Bind each claim to its artifact, source, corpus, protocol, environment and coverage. Performance repetitions execute fresh inference and identify every attempt; separate cold load, warm execution, first partial, finalization and publication. Profile separately from timing. Boundary heap samples are not process peak memory; unknown counters stay absent and unavailable peak/VRAM cannot support promotion. Report failures, denominators and no-gain outcomes. Promotion uses existing quality/resource policy. Static DSP parity is not ASR parity, mel-chunk parity is not raw-waveform or HTTP streaming, and frame advances or VAD segment offsets are not word timestamps. Where the native offline and streaming modes differ, compare each with its own pinned oracle and disclose the difference instead of forcing equality. Preserve incremental waveform preprocessing, bounded recurrent checkpoint/restart and authenticated partial/final HTTP when extending audio service. Preserve AudioStreamCursor progress and checkpoint ownership and AudioStreamSession concurrency/residency ownership; no growing-prefix replay or second scheduler. Then prove live switching/concurrency and reuse those consumers for routing and recovery. Synthesis lifecycle and CPU artifact admission remain independent alternatives before full-encoder expansion. Alignment needs validated emissions, not a trained adapter or live switching; generative audio depends on its elected operations, not ASR CUDA. Preserve the remaining voice, speaker, synthesis, generation, gradient, device and audio-conditioned adaptation obligations without claiming them from numerical or contract-only fixtures. Every retained row keeps a non-vacuous acceptance command, exact identity and capability obligation. Planned acceptance names are work to implement, not existing success claims. Require nonempty executed cases and fail on missing artifacts or skipped required subchecks. Read every group member before editing. Each lead implements all member contracts and binds component acceptance in verification_batch before integration; later rows are exact verification receipts. Dependencies target the last required prerequisite receipt. The current gate advances one row per commit: grouping alone proves neither fewer commits nor a speedup. No provisional commits, manual pruning, cross-group source accumulation or weaker acceptance. Use the existing gate, source-isolated execution, transaction-scoped store ownership, terminal package/checkpoint evidence and conservative runtime-file/subprocess-input graph. Reuse only exact independent passing evidence; preserve failed attempts and outstanding obligations across interruption. Measure setup, reused/executed checks and total gate wall. Master owns broad model benchmarking, shared GPU-admission changes and platform cleanup; inspect landed implementation before relying on a planned improvement. Audio's batch/recovery proof exercises these owners rather than rebuilding them. Inspect live CPU/RAM/VRAM capacity instead of assuming historical occupancy. Correctness work may share fitting VRAM only when the landed resource owner admits it; performance and device-wide memory measurements remain exclusive. Free VRAM does not bypass an OS-held exclusive reservation. Required device checks cannot be masked or skipped. On admission refusal preserve evidence, stop unchanged retries, and select dependency-ready CPU work through the existing frontier/reorder owner. Do not terminate other worktrees' processes or clear their reservations. A pending merge blocks only conflicting source/commit operations: preserve its exact recoverable candidate and hold independent CPU development separately; never change a candidate during its active gate.
